description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the RetrieveResourcesResponse class, which is part of a policy command response framework in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.policies.query package. It verifies immutability, equality semantics, JSON serialization, and deserialization functionalities.

classes.name: RetrieveResourcesResponseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the RetrieveResourcesResponse class, testing its immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and creation from JSON.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of RetrieveResourcesResponse are immutable, using MutabilityAssert.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode() and equals() methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullResources
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveResourcesResponse instance with null resources throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveResourcesResponse instance with null JSON object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an instance of RetrieveResourcesResponse from a valid JSON object.
